# Zoiris Cleaning Services LLC

> Zoiris Cleaning Services LLC is a licensed, bonded, and insured residential and commercial cleaning company headquartered in Downtown Mobile, Alabama (ZIP 36602), serving Mobile, Semmes, Theodore, Saraland, Baldwin County (Daphne, Fairhope, Spanish Fort, Foley, Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, Fort Morgan), Birmingham, Huntsville, Montgomery, Tuscaloosa, Auburn, and all 67 counties / 503 municipalities across the State of Alabama.

## Core Facts & Contact
- **Phone (24/7 Dispatch & Instant Flat-Rate Quotes):** (251) 220-2515 (`+1-251-220-2515`)
- **Email:** zoiriscleaningservices@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/
- **Contract Policy:** 100% No Locked Contracts, Zero Rescheduling Penalties, Zero Travel Surcharges
- **Staffing & Safety:** Vetted, background-checked W-2 employees (never unscreened gig subcontractors); Commercial 0.3-micron HEPA filtration vacuums; EPA-registered child- and pet-safe disinfectants; Full General Liability & Workers' Compensation Insurance
- **Guarantee:** 24-Hour 100% Re-Clean Satisfaction Guarantee

## Typical Alabama Flat-Rate Cleaning Benchmarks (2026)
- **Recurring House Cleaning & Maid Service:** $125–$225 per visit (Weekly, Bi-Weekly, Monthly)
- **Top-to-Bottom Deep Cleaning:** $220–$440 flat rate
- **Move-In / Move-Out Empty-Home Turnover:** $250–$495 flat rate (Landlord Deposit Checklist)
- **Airbnb & Vacation Rental Same-Day Turnover (10 AM–3 PM):** $140–$340 per turnover
- **Commercial, Office & Medical/Dental Janitorial:** Custom flat monthly or per-visit pricing ($0.08–$0.20/sq ft)

## High-Demand Pricing & Checklist Guides
- [2026 House Cleaning & Maid Service Cost Guide (Alabama & Gulf Coast)](https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/guides/house-cleaning-cost-guide-alabama/): In Alabama (including Mobile, Baldwin County, Birmingham, Huntsville, and Montgomery), standard recurring house cleaning costs $125 to $225 per visit ($0.07–$0.12/sq ft), top-to-bottom deep cleaning costs $220 to $440 ($0.14–$0.22/sq ft), and empty-home move-in/move-out cleaning ranges from $250 to $495 depending on home size and bathroom count, with 10%–20% savings on weekly or bi-weekly plans.
- [The Ultimate Landlord-Approved Move-Out Cleaning Checklist](https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/guides/ultimate-move-out-cleaning-checklist/): To pass a landlord move-out inspection and secure a 100% security deposit refund, tenants must empty and wipe inside all cabinets, drawers, and closets; degrease the oven interior, drip pans, range hood, and refrigerator shelves; descale shower glass, tubs, and toilets; wet-wash all baseboards, blinds, and door frames; remove wall scuffs; and vacuum and mop every floor edge-to-edge.
- [Deep Cleaning vs. Regular House Cleaning: What's the Real Difference?](https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/guides/deep-cleaning-vs-regular-cleaning/): Regular house cleaning maintains weekly or bi-weekly surface hygiene—sanitizing countertops, sinks, toilets, showers, mirrors, and vacuuming/mopping floors. Deep cleaning adds intensive vertical and detail labor: hand-washing baseboards, doors, window frames, and blinds; descaling heavy shower grout and mineral buildup; degreasing range hoods; and dusting ceiling fan blades and HVAC vents.
- [5-Star Airbnb & Vacation Rental Turnover Checklist (Superhost Protocol)](https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/guides/airbnb-turnover-cleaning-checklist/): A 5-star Airbnb turnover requires six synchronized steps between 10:00 AM checkout and 3:00 PM check-in: immediate damage and left-item photo logging, stripping and laundering/swapping par-stock bed and bath linens, food-free refrigerator and dishwasher reset, LED zero-hair bathroom sterilization, HEPA sand and pet-dander floor extraction, and staged welcome amenities verified by timestamped host photos.
- [Commercial Cleaning & Office Janitorial Pricing + Scope Matrix](https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/guides/commercial-office-cleaning-checklist-pricing/): Commercial office and facility cleaning in Alabama typically costs $0.08 to $0.20 per square foot per visit (or $250 to $1,800+ per month for recurring 1x–5x weekly schedules), depending on restroom count, foot traffic, floor types (VCT vs. carpet), and whether clinical EPA List N medical disinfection is required.
- [Removing Alabama Red Clay, Coastal Mildew, Hard-Water Scale & Pollen](https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/guides/remove-red-clay-mildew-hard-water-stains/): Iron-rich Alabama red clay requires dry HEPA vacuuming first followed by a neutral detergent and tannin/iron spotter—never hot bleach, which sets iron oxide permanently. Subtropical bathroom mildew responds best to EPA-registered peroxide or botanical thymol disinfectants with a full 10-minute dwell time, while cloudy shower glass requires acid-free mineral descalers rather than abrasive pads.
- [3-Phase Post-Construction & Renovation Cleaning Checklist](https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/guides/post-construction-cleaning-checklist-phases/): Professional post-construction cleanup is executed in three sequential phases: Phase 1 (Rough Clean) removes construction debris, floor ram-board, and window manufacturer stickers; Phase 2 (Final Detail Clean) performs top-down sealed HEPA extraction of drywall dust inside every vent, cabinet hinge, drawer track, baseboard, and fixture; Phase 3 (Touch-Up Clean) polishes glass and floors after final punch-list trades exit.
- [Hot-Water Extraction Steam Cleaning vs. Carpet Shampooing & Dry Bonnet](https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/guides/carpet-steam-cleaning-vs-shampooing-guide/): Major carpet mills (including Shaw and Mohawk) recommend hot-water extraction ('steam cleaning') because 200°F pressurized water and high-lift vacuum suction flush both deep-embedded grit and cleaning solution out of the carpet pile. Traditional rotary shampooing leaves sticky soap residue that attracts dirt rapidly, while dry bonnet pads only buff the top 15% of fibers.
- [Soft Washing vs. Pressure Washing: Safe PSI Chart by Exterior Surface](https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/guides/soft-washing-vs-pressure-washing-guide/): High-pressure washing (2,500–3,500 PSI with a rotary surface cleaner) should only be used on cured concrete driveways, sidewalks, and commercial aprons. House siding (vinyl, Hardie plank, painted brick, stucco, and soffits) must be soft-washed at under 100 PSI using biodegradable algaecide surfactants that kill mold and Gloeocapsa algae spores without forcing water behind siding or etching paint.
- [How Often Should Everything in Your Home Be Cleaned? (Master Chart)](https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/guides/home-cleaning-frequency-schedule-chart/): For healthy indoor air quality and surface hygiene, kitchen counters and dishes require daily wiping; bathrooms, bed sheets, high-touch handles, and HEPA vacuuming/mopping should be completed weekly (or bi-weekly for lower-traffic homes); microwaves, fridge shelves, and ceiling fans monthly; baseboards, blinds, and ovens quarterly; and carpet steam extraction, window washing, and gutter clearing every 6 months.

## Complete 29 Specialized Cleaning Services
- **House Cleaning & Maid Service** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/house-cleaning/`): Customized recurring and on-demand residential housekeeping and maid service engineered to keep kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living areas spotless, sanitized, and allergen-free. Equipment: Multi-stage commercial HEPA filtration vacuums (0.3-micron capture), color-coded microfiber cloths, pH-neutral hardwood/stone cleaners, and EPA-registered non-toxic surface disinfectants.
- **Deep Cleaning Services** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/deep-cleaning/`): Intensive restorative house scrub targeting heavy buildup, hand-scrubbed baseboards, blinds, air vents, shower scale, and kitchen grease before starting routine maid care or seasonal resets. Equipment: Oscillating grout detail brushes, botanical citrus degreasers, acid-free mineral descalers, telescoping ceiling dusters, and sealed HEPA canister vacuums.
- **Move-In Cleaning** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/move-in-cleaning/`): Complete pre-occupancy sanitization of vacant houses, condos, and apartments so incoming families unpack dishes, clothes, and groceries onto sterile shelves and spotless floors. Equipment: EPA List N hospital-grade botanical disinfectants, food-safe cabinet & refrigerator sanitizers, steam detailers, and HEPA particulate vacuums.
- **Move-Out Cleaning** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/move-out-cleaning/`): Empty-property turnover cleaning engineered around Alabama landlord, apartment community, and real estate listing inspection checklists to secure security deposits and speed up closings. Equipment: Heavy-duty carbonized oven degreasers, non-scratch scuff erasers, commercial HEPA vacuums, interior cabinet vacuums, and streak-free glass polishers.
- **Carpet & Upholstery Steam Cleaning** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/carpet-cleaning/`): High-temperature hot-water extraction (steam cleaning), bio-enzymatic pet odor neutralization, and upholstery fabric care removing deep-embedded soil, red clay, sand, and allergens. Equipment: High-PSI heated hot-water extraction units, counter-rotating pile agitators, bio-enzymatic pet urine neutralizers, low-moisture upholstery hand tools, and high-velocity air movers.
- **Window Cleaning Services** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/window-cleaning/`): Streak-free interior and exterior window washing utilizing multi-stage deionized pure water poles, surgical rubber squeegees, screen baths, and deep sill/track dirt extraction. Equipment: 4-stage RO/DI purified water-fed carbon-fiber poles (spot-free drying), Ettore/Moerman brass & stainless squeegees, non-scratch bronze wool pads, and track vacuum nozzles.
- **Pressure Washing & Soft Washing** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/pressure-washing/`): Commercial rotary concrete pressure washing for driveways, sidewalks, and pool decks paired with damage-free low-pressure soft washing for vinyl, Hardie plank, brick, and stucco siding. Equipment: 4+ GPM commercial belt-drive pressure washers, 20-inch rotary concrete surface cleaners (zero zebra stripes), dedicated 60-PSI soft-wash proportioners, and biodegradable algaecide surfactants.
- **Gutter & Downspout Cleaning** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/gutter-cleaning/`): Hand-cleared gutter trough cleaning and pressurized downspout flushing removing compacted pine straw, live oak leaves, shingle granules, and roof moss before heavy Alabama rainstorms. Equipment: OSHA-rated ladder standoffs (never resting on gutter lips), gutter scoopers, pressurized downspout hydro-jet nozzles, and heavy-duty debris collection bags.
- **Luxury Estate & Fine Home Cleaning** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/luxury-estate-cleaning/`): Discreet, conservation-grade white-glove housekeeping tailored for 3,500+ sq ft residences, bayfront/lakefront estates, and homes featuring Calacatta marble, heart pine, antique millwork, and fine art. Equipment: Stone-safe neutral pH marble cleansers, Bona Pro hardwood systems, ultra-plush 500-GSM edgeless microfiber, horsehair brush HEPA attachments, and fragrance-free botanical sanitizers.
- **Residential Laundry & Linen Service** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/laundry-services/`): Dedicated in-home wash, dry, crisp fold, closet organization, and hotel-style bed linen changing for busy households, seniors, and short-term vacation rental properties. Equipment: Fabric-safe sorting protocols, hypoallergenic/free-and-clear detergent compatibility, delicate garment mesh bags, steam wrinkle release, and crisp retail/hotel folding boards.
- **Interior Surface & Home Detailing** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/detailing/`): Surgical micro-detailing of high-wear interior zones—including oven/fridge interiors, cabinet hinges, tile grout lines, window blinds, HVAC registers, and architectural trim—restoring showroom brilliance. Equipment: 275°F dry-vapor steam detailers, Boar's-hair crevice brushes, non-scratch melamine & razor glass scrapers, stainless grain polishers, and HEPA micro-nozzle vacuums.
- **Commercial Cleaning Services** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/commercial-cleaning/`): Comprehensive commercial building sanitation and presentation care tailored for customer-facing retail spaces, financial branches, auto showrooms, and corporate centers with zero operational disruption. Equipment: CRI-certified commercial backpack HEPA vacuums, hospital-grade quaternary/botanical EPA List N disinfectants, flat microfiber damp-mop systems, and commercial glass/floor equipment.
- **Office Cleaning & Workplace Janitorial** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/office-janitorial-services/`): Specialized corporate and small-business office cleaning focused on employee wellness, reduced sick days, electronics-safe workstation dusting, conference room readiness, and hygienic office breakrooms. Equipment: Quiet-decibel HEPA backpack vacuums, anti-static electronics-safe microfiber, touchpoint sanitizing wipes, and color-coded restroom vs. breakroom sanitation kits.
- **Contract Janitorial & Day Porter Services** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/janitorial-cleaning-services/`): Full-scope ongoing custodial management, day-porter attendance, multi-restroom consumable logistics, and scheduled floor care for high-traffic multi-tenant, municipal, and institutional buildings. Equipment: Commercial janitorial carts, closed-loop chemical dilution dispensers, high-capacity walk-behind floor scrubbers, HEPA vacuums, and digital quality-audit checklists.
- **Medical & Dental Facility Cleaning** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/medical-dental-facility-cleaning/`): Healthcare-grade environmental sanitation engineered around CDC, OSHA bloodborne pathogen awareness, and HIPAA privacy protocols for outpatient clinics, dental operatories, physical therapy, and urgent care centers. Equipment: EPA List N hospital-grade tuberculocidal/virucidal disinfectants (verified dwell-time compliance), sealed ULPA/HEPA vacuums, single-room color-coded microfiber, and no-dip flat mop heads.
- **Industrial & Warehouse Cleaning** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/industrial-warehouse-cleaning/`): Heavy-duty industrial sanitation for warehouses, logistics hubs, manufacturing plants, and fabrication shops—keeping concrete aisles, loading bays, employee locker rooms, and front offices safe and audit-ready. Equipment: Cylindrical/disc concrete floor auto-scrubbers, industrial wet/dry HEPA shop extractors, forklift-tire mark degreasers, high-bay extension dusters, and OSHA PPE gear.
- **Floor Stripping, Waxing & Hard Floor Care** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/floor-stripping-waxing/`): Complete hard-floor restoration including old yellowed acrylic wax stripping, pH neutralizing rinses, 4-to-6 coat high-solids commercial polymer finish application, high-speed burnishing, and tile/hardwood deep care. Equipment: 175-RPM weighted rotary swing machines with black stripping pads, wet-vac slurry extractors, pH-neutralizing rinses, rayon/microfiber finish applicators, and 1500+ RPM propane/electric burnishers.
- **Gym, Studio & Fitness Center Cleaning** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/gym-fitness-center-cleaning/`): Specialized athletic facility sanitation neutralizing sweat odors, staph/MRSA, athlete's foot fungi, and chalk buildup across cardio decks, free weights, rubber/turf flooring, wall mirrors, and shower locker rooms. Equipment: Non-corrosive EPA fungicidal/bactericidal equipment disinfectants (safe on vinyl pads & chrome), rubber-floor auto-scrubbers, locker-shower steam descalers, and HEPA chalk vacuums.
- **School, Preschool & Daycare Cleaning** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/school-daycare-cleaning/`): Pediatric-safe educational facility sanitation combining non-toxic EPA-registered botanical disinfectants, background-screened staff, and meticulous high-touch desk, cubby, nap-mat, and restroom hygiene. Equipment: EPA Safer Choice / Design for the Environment non-toxic virucidal disinfectants, sealed HEPA vacuums (asthma-safe), food-safe cafeteria sanitizers, and color-coded microfiber.
- **Church & Worship Center Cleaning** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/church-worship-center-cleaning/`): Respectful, budget-conscious worship facility cleaning preparing sanctuaries, wooden pews, upholstered auditorium seating, church nurseries, fellowship halls, and lobbies for Sunday services, midweek ministries, and weddings. Equipment: Wood-preserving pew polishers, wide-area quiet HEPA carpet vacuums, child-safe nursery disinfectants, commercial kitchen degreasers, and high-ceiling cobweb extension poles.
- **Solar Panel Cleaning Services** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/solar-panel-cleaning/`): Manufacturer-compliant photovoltaic (PV) solar array cleaning using 0-TDS deionized pure water and soft boar's-hair/nylon solar brushes—restoring 15–25% lost energy production without harsh chemicals or pressure damage. Equipment: 4-stage RO/DI 000-TDS deionized water filtration systems, non-abrasive soft solar-specific water-fed brushes, carbon-fiber insulated extension poles, and roof safety harnesses.
- **Vacation Rental Turnover Cleaning** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/vacation-rental-cleaning/`): High-speed hospitality turnover cleaning engineered for multi-bedroom vacation homes, beachfront condos, lake houses, and VRBO properties requiring flawless 10 AM to 3 PM guest turnarounds. Equipment: High-agitation HEPA sand/pet extractors, hospitality bed-staging kits, stainless/glass anti-salt polishers, amenity restock checklists, and timestamped photo verification.
- **Airbnb Host Turnover Cleaning** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/airbnb-cleaning/`): Superhost-standard Airbnb turnover cleaning structured around Airbnb's 5-Step Enhanced Cleaning Process—preventing hair, smudge, odor, or dusty-baseboard complaints that hurt listing search rank. Equipment: Lint-roller & blacklight/LED hair-check protocol, HEPA filtration vacuums, odor-eliminating botanical sanitizers, coffee/consumable staging checklists, and host photo alerts.
- **Airbnb & Vacation Rental Operations Support** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/airbnb-vacation-rental-management/`): Turnkey local boots-on-the-ground operations for remote short-term rental investors—combining automated turnover coordination, par-stock linen management, consumable inventory replenishment, and between-guest maintenance inspections. Equipment: iCal/PMS turnover scheduling sync, standardized property staging playbooks, consumable inventory tracking logs, smart-lock battery/code checks, and digital inspection reports.
- **Post-Construction & Remodel Cleanup** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/post-construction-cleanup/`): Three-phase construction turnover cleaning for general contractors, custom home builders, commercial build-outs, and home remodelers—eliminating ultrafine gypsum/silica dust from every register, cabinet, track, and floor. Equipment: Sealed commercial HEPA fine-dust extractors, non-scratch glass razor blades, masonry/grout-haze removers, adhesive solvents, extension pole vacuums, and OSHA PPE.
- **Property Management, Apartment & HOA Cleaning** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/property-management-janitorial/`): Dedicated vendor partner for residential property managers, apartment communities, condo associations (HOAs), and commercial landlords—delivering rapid vacant unit make-readies and spotless common-area upkeep. Equipment: Multi-crew make-ready turnover kits, corridor HEPA backpack vacuums, elevator/stainless polishers, clubhouse/gym disinfectants, and consolidated Net-15/monthly PM invoicing.
- **Exterior & Interior Property Upkeep Services** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/property-maintenance/`): Bundled year-round preventative property preservation combining interior sanitation, breezeway/porch sweeping, cobweb and wasp-nest clearing, gutter drainage checks, and exterior wash upkeep. Equipment: Soft-wash exterior sprayers, telescoping cobweb/eave poles, gutter inspection tools, commercial blowers/vacuums, and interior sanitization kits.
- **Home Watch & Vacant Residence Care** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/home-watch-services/`): Scheduled visual property inspections and pre-arrival housekeeping for snowbirds, coastal second-home owners, frequent travelers, and vacant estates—catching AC failures, humidity mold, or water leaks before damage spreads. Equipment: Digital indoor hygrometers (humidity/temp verification), moisture-check flashlights, timestamped photo inspection checklists, and pre-arrival white-glove refresh kits.
- **Luxury Estate Housekeeping & Stewardship** (`https://www.zoiriscleaningservices.com/services/luxury-estate-management/`): Coordinated year-round household care for large private residences and multi-residence families—integrating recurring white-glove housekeeping, seasonal exterior/window/carpet scheduling, guest-wing readiness, and private event resets. Equipment: Custom estate care binders, conservation-grade surface products, dedicated senior crew leaders, seasonal maintenance calendars, and private-client dispatch priority.
